dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, I want to spend three days by the sea. Where should I go?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈspɛnd ˈθriː ˈdeɪz baɪ ðə ˈsiː. ˈwɛr ʃʊd aɪ ˈɡoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thailand has two coasts, and both are beautiful.
dialogue.reading: ˈtaɪlænd ˈhæz ˈtuː ˈkoʊsts, ənd ˈboʊθ ər ˈbjuːtəfəl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Which one do you like more?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɪtʃ ˈwʌn duː juː ˈlaɪk ˈmɔːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The west coast. Koh Lipe is one of the most beautiful islands in Thailand. The sand is white and soft.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈwɛst ˈkoʊst. ˈkoʊ ˈliːpeɪ ɪz ˈwʌn əv ðə ˈmoʊst ˈbjuːtəfəl ˈaɪləndz ɪn ˈtaɪlænd. ðə ˈsænd ɪz ˈwaɪt ənd ˈsɔːft.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! It has some of the best coral reefs in the country.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ɪt ˈhæz sʌm əv ðə ˈbɛst ˈkɔːrəl ˈriːfs ɪn ðə ˈkʌntri.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What about diving? I've always wanted to try it.
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈdaɪvɪŋ? aɪv ˈɔːlweɪz ˈwɑːntɪd tə ˈtraɪ ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then go to Koh Tao. It's one of the cheapest places in the world to learn diving.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈɡoʊ tə ˈkoʊ ˈtaʊ. ɪts ˈwʌn əv ðə ˈtʃiːpɪst ˈpleɪsɪz ɪn ðə ˈwɜːrld tə ˈlɜːrn ˈdaɪvɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Is Koh Tao on the same coast?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ˈkoʊ ˈtaʊ ɑːn ðə ˈseɪm ˈkoʊst?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it's on the other coast. It's a long trip from Koh Lipe.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪts ɑːn ði ˈʌðər ˈkoʊst. ɪts ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtrɪp frəm ˈkoʊ ˈliːpeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And Maya Bay? I saw it in a movie.
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈmaɪə ˈbeɪ? aɪ ˈsɔː ɪt ɪn ə ˈmuːvi.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's one of the most famous bays in the world, but you can't swim there any more.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈwʌn əv ðə ˈmoʊst ˈfeɪməs ˈbeɪz ɪn ðə ˈwɜːrld, bʌt juː ˈkænt ˈswɪm ˈðɛr ˈɛni ˈmɔːr.
